phase: Product UX and visual development before and during live traffic

current_task.title: Performance and visual stability
current_task.objective: Reduce client overhead, cascade complexity and layout instability while preserving the locked five-viewport product contract and strong recovery UX.
current_task.next_action: Continue the whole V2 recovery/performance audit rather than speculative micro-optimization. First inspect catalog bootstrap/change failure UX and search-continue recovery for user-visible dead ends; fix only confirmed issues. Then reassess whether B7 has enough remaining material evidence to stay open or can be closed pending real traffic. Progressive result dedup is explicitly deferred: live PR #40 observed only two material snapshots (37% and 100%) and both differed. Keep the lead-form-guard selectedTour MutationObserver intact; do not bundle JS merely to reduce request count.

queue.title: Performance and visual stability
queue.note: B7 production-green work includes CSS request/cascade reduction, safe live-read timeout hardening, selected-tour desktop image CLS reservation, mobile-only lazy initialization, deferred hidden result-state DOM, removal/lazy-binding of empty startup scans/listeners, cached result counts, and hot-path formatter reuse. PR #39 cached the results renderer Intl.NumberFormat and passed deploy/live/post-deploy/baseline. PR #41 cached the automatically repeated search-status minPrice formatter and passed deploy/live/post-deploy/baseline. Temporary diagnostic PR #40 sampled one real progressive search: 25 hotels at 37% and 25 hotels at 100% had different material fingerprints (changed_transitions=1, unchanged_transitions=0); it was closed without merge, disproving the current case for payload-dedup/incremental-render complexity. Whole-flow audit then found a selected-tour recovery dead end: transient tour API failure offered only back-to-results. PR #42 added in-place `Повторить загрузку тура` through the existing guarded selectTour path; all six PR gates passed, merged as ad4f90aac263c7583d06e98b5c55efa5383869ae, deploy 33091140734, active contract 33091140572, tour live 33091140613, flights live 33091140661, result-detail live 33091140648, security 33091140856, post-deploy visual 33091226239 and baseline 33091226226 all passed. Selected-tour/flight formatter allocations and per-card matchMedia remain deferred as lower-frequency/smaller than proven targets.
